subject: Mathematics
summary: Lesson 4 hits the B1.6 mark cleanly: the leftover-fraction trap (18 divided by 8 = 2 1/4) is a research-grounded Grade-3 misconception with concrete, branched recovery moves; materials are everyday (paper treats, plates, chart) with the puppet explicitly OPTIONAL and a teacher-voice substitute; conceptual progression from dealing to leftover-cutting to mixed-number notation is explicit; worksheet Parts 1-3 each map to a named success criterion with Part 3 introducing a transfer task (find multiple sharer counts for 20). Clarity_voice sits at 3 because Sammy anchors the minds_on and consolidation but lacks a distinctive quotable refrain or memorable chant carried between lessons (Level 4 bar).
